observations: A game console with a custom yellow and red skin.
The skin features a 'Cyclopentam' logo and a '5000' graphic.
A white controller with a custom skin is resting on top.
The console has a black power cable and a black USB cable.
The Xbox logo is visible on the side of the console.
The console is sitting on a grey fabric surface with a pillow in the background.

claims.evidence: The photos show a custom skin, which can hide wear, but the console itself appears clean.
No photo shows the console powered on or the controller connected.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the console menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the Xbox Live service.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the console's 'System' settings showing the account status.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and navigating the menu.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the console menu.
Screenshot of the console's system settings showing the account status.
Photo of the rear ports and the power indicator light while the console is on.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
